🎓 **NextStep** is a comprehensive Learning & Career Guidance Platform! It offers:
• 📚 IT & Business courses with video + quizzes
• 🤖 AI-powered career chatbot (that's me!)
• 📄 Resume upload with automatic skill extraction
• 💼 Live job recommendations from LinkedIn & Naukri
• 🏆 Shareable completion certificates
• 📊 Skill Gap Analysis to target your upskilling

🚀 Here's your **Getting Started** guide:
1️⃣ **Register** with your name, email & password
2️⃣ **Complete 3 Aptitude** modules first (required to unlock courses)
3️⃣ **Upload your Resume** to auto-extract your skills
4️⃣ **Browse main IT/Business** courses
5️⃣ **Check Job Matches** based on your skills
6️⃣ **Download Certificates** after scoring 10+

Start with Aptitude training from your Dashboard!

📝 **Aptitude Training** is the gateway to all main courses on NextStep!

It has 3 modules:
• 🧠 **Logical Aptitude** – Logical reasoning & critical thinking
• 🔢 **Quantitative Aptitude** – Math-based problem solving
• 🗣️ **Communication Aptitude** – Verbal & communication skills

You need to score **10+ marks** in each module to unlock IT & Business courses. This ensures you have the foundational skills for professional growth!

📚 **NextStep Courses** are organized in 3 categories:

🖥️ **IT Courses** – Programming, Web Development, Databases, Cloud, AI/ML
💼 **Business Courses** – Management, Communication, Digital Marketing, Finance
🎯 **Aptitude** (Complete first!) – Logical, Quantitative, Communication

You must pass all 3 Aptitude modules before accessing IT & Business courses. Visit your **Dashboard** to see all available courses!

📋 **Enrolling in a Course:**
1. Complete all 3 **Aptitude** modules first (score 10+ each)
2. Go to your **Student Dashboard**
3. Browse **IT** or **Business** courses
4. Click **'Enroll'** on your chosen course
5. Watch the course **video** to completion
6. Take the **quiz** and score 10+ to get your certificate!

💡 Tip: First-time users must unlock courses through Aptitude!

🏆 **Getting Your Certificate:**

✅ Score **10 or more marks** in any course quiz
✅ Navigate to the **Certificate** page for that course
✅ Click **'Download PDF'** to save your certificate

Your certificate includes:
• Your full name
• Course title
• Completion date
• Official seal & signature

You can use it to showcase your skills on LinkedIn! 🌟

📝 **Quiz Guide:**

1. Watch the course video fully
2. Click **'Take Quiz'** or 'Complete Video'
3. Answer all **multiple-choice** questions (select 1 of 4 options)
4. Click **'Submit Quiz'** when done
5. View your score instantly!

🎯 **Passing Score:** 10 marks
📋 Each correct answer = 1 mark
🔄 You can **retake** the quiz to improve your score

Good luck! 💪

📄 **Resume Upload & Skill Extraction:**

1. Go to your **Profile** page (click 'Profile' in navbar)
2. Under **'Resume'** section, click 'Choose File'
3. Select your **PDF or DOCX** resume
4. Click **'Upload & Extract Skills'**

🤖 The AI automatically scans your resume for tech keywords:
Python, Java, SQL, Machine Learning, React, AWS, Docker, and 15+ more!

Extracted skills are added to your profile, improving your **job match accuracy**! 📊

👤 **Updating Your Profile:**

Go to **Profile** → You can update:
• 📚 **Education** – Your degree, university, graduation year
• 💼 **Experience** – Work experience, internships, projects
• 🛠️ **Skills** – Add skills manually (comma-separated)
• 📄 **Resume** – Upload PDF/DOCX to auto-extract skills

A complete profile gets **more accurate job recommendations**! The more skills you add, the better the job matches. 🎯

📊 **Skill Gap Analysis on NextStep:**

Our AI compares your **current skills** against job requirements:

✅ **Matched Skills** – You already have these (shown in green)
❌ **Missing Skills** – You need to learn these (shown in red)
📊 **Match %** – How qualified you are for each job

**How to close skill gaps:**
1. Go to **Jobs** page to see your gaps
2. Visit **Dashboard** – 'Recommended for You' section shows courses targeting your gaps
3. Complete those courses to boost your match %!

Start with courses that fix your biggest skill gaps! 🎯

💼 **Live Job Recommendations:**

Navigate to **Jobs** in the navbar to see:

🔴 **LinkedIn & Naukri** live job listings matched to YOUR skills
📊 **Match percentage** for each job (how qualified you are)
✅ Green skills = You have them
❌ Red skills = You're missing these
📚 'Upskill in...' = Courses targeting your skill gaps
🔗 **Apply Now** button = Direct link to original job posting

Jobs are ranked by **highest match % first**. Update your profile skills to improve your job matches! 🚀

📍 **Junior Developer** → **Mid-Level Developer** → **Senior Developer** → **Tech Lead**

**Key Skills to Build:**
• Programming: Python, Java, JavaScript
• Web: HTML, CSS, React/Angular
• Database: SQL, MongoDB
• Cloud: AWS, Azure
• Tools: Git, Docker

**Recommended Learning Path:**
1️⃣ Complete Aptitude modules on NextStep
2️⃣ Enroll in IT courses (Web Dev, Programming)
3️⃣ Build projects for your portfolio
4️⃣ Get certified to boost your profile!

Want me to suggest specific courses based on your skills?

🎓 Data Analyst → 🔬 Data Scientist → 🏗️ ML Engineer → 🏛️ AI Architect

• Practice DSA on LeetCode / HackerRank

• Ask clarifying questions
• Be confident but honest about gaps

🎓 **MBA vs M.Tech - Which to Choose?**

**Choose M.Tech if you:**
• Love deep technical work
• Want research/academic career
• Targeting FAANG or deep tech roles
• Strong in mathematics & programming

**Choose MBA if you:**
• Want management/leadership roles
• Interested in business & strategy
• Building entrepreneurial skills
• Switching to product management

**Both Paths Lead To Success!**
• M.Tech: IITs, NITs, top private colleges
• MBA: IIMs, top non-IIM colleges (XLRI, IIFT)

**Alternative:** Build skills + work experience first, then decide. Many professionals skip PG and still have excellent careers! 💪
